Author: Rajiv Gupta
Bench: Rajiv Gupta
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 65
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 37518 of 2022
Applicant :- Neetu @ Netrapal And 4 Others
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Vishal Agarwal

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Case No. 421 of 2015, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act,
P.S. Kekar Kheda, District- Meerut, pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Meerut.
As per the allegations made in the first information report, it is alleged that opposite party No. 3 was married to applicant No. 1 on 17.4.2009, however, after the said marriage, the applicants started making additional demand for dowry and for non-fulfilment of demand of additional dowry used to torture her, maltreated her and subjected her to cruelty and turned her out of her matrimonial home.
Neetu @ Netrapal And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117249652/

entities.text: Neetu @ Netrapal And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that from the perusal of the allegations made in the FIR and the material collected during the course of investigation, no offence is disclosed against the applicants and the present prosecution has been instituted with a malafide intention for the purposes of harassment.

Per contra, learned AGA has submitted that from the perusal of the allegations made in the FIR and the material collected during the course of investigation, prima facie offence is clearly made out against the applicant Nos. 1 and 2.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, so far as the applicant Nos. 1 and 2 is concerned, the prayer for quashing the entire proceedings is refused.

However, in case the applicant Nos. 1 and 2 appear before the court below within three weeks from today and apply for bail, their bail application be considered and disposed of in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2021) 10 SCC 773 after hearing the parties.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2021) 10 SCC 773
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: With the aforesaid observation, the instant application on behalf of applicant Nos 1 and 2 stands disposed of.

It is further submitted that applicant Nos. 3, 4 and 5 are the brother in-law and sisters in-law of opposite party No. 3 and they have no concern whatsoever with her day to day affairs and have been falsely roped in only on account of being the relative of her husband.
So far as the applicant nos. 3, 4 and 5 are concerned, issue notice to opposite party Nos. 2 and 3,
who may file counter affidavit within four weeks.
Learned AGA may also file counter affidavit within the same period.
Rejoinder affidavit, if any, may be filed within tow weeks thereafter.

Till then, no coercive steps shall be taken against the applicant Nos. 3 to 5 in Case No. 421 of 2015,
under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Kekar Kheda, District- Meerut,
pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Meerut.
